why.text: Light, sandy soils on a peninsula between the Tejo and Sado estuaries, with a mixed subtropical and Mediterranean/maritime climate and the Arrábida hills, suit aromatic Moscatel grapes made into fortified wine.

styles.text: Only fortified (licoroso) wine: white Moscatel de Setúbal and red Moscatel Roxo.

climate.text: Mixed subtropical and Mediterranean/maritime, with low rainfall and moderate temperature swings. It is shaped by the sea, the Sado and Tejo basins and the Arrábida hills.

soil.text: Mostly light, sandy soils with some patches of different texture and little or no aggregation.

tastes.text: White: golden, topaz to amber, exotic orange blossom and linden, honey, dates and orange; older wines show hazelnuts, almonds and walnuts. Red (Roxo): drier, more complex aroma, very fine palate with spice and ginja and fig preserves.

styles.name: Moscatel de Setúbal
styles.text: White fortified wine with at least 85% Moscatel de Setúbal grape.

styles.name: Moscatel Roxo
styles.text: Red fortified wine with at least 85% Moscatel Roxo grape.

styles.name: Superior
styles.text: Top-rated wine aged at least five years before sale.

styles.name: 10, 20, 30 or 40 anos
styles.text: Age statements allowed if the wine is at least that old.

why.text: Light, sandy soils on a peninsula between the Tejo and Sado estuaries, with low rain and a mixed climate shaped by the sea, give fruity reds and fresh whites.

styles.text: Reds, whites and rosés, plus semi-sparkling (frisante), sparkling and fortified (licoroso) wines.

climate.text: Mixed sub-tropical and Mediterranean/maritime, with low rainfall and moderate temperature swings. It is shaped by the sea, the Sado and Tejo basins and the Arrábida range.

soil.text: Mostly light, sandy soils with some patches of varying texture. Recommended types are psammitic regosols, brown and red calcareous soils, non-humic lithosols and podzolised sands.

tastes.text: Reds: full-bodied, deep garnet, red fruit and jam with dried fruit and spice, softening with age. Whites: lemon-yellow, fruity, fresh, well-structured acidity. Rosés: bright pink, strawberry and redcurrant, refreshing. Fortified: amber, citrus, honey and dried fruit.

styles.name: Licoroso
styles.text: Fortified wine, at least 16% alcohol, amber with citrus, honey and dried-fruit aromas.

styles.name: Espumante
styles.text: Sparkling wine, base wine must be DO Palmela, with a second fermentation; at least 10% alcohol.

styles.name: Frisante
styles.text: Semi-sparkling wine from DO Palmela base wine with a second fermentation; at least 10% alcohol.

styles.name: Rosado
styles.text: Pink wine from red grapes, or white up to one third, made in open-run style.
